description: DGKS Kreuzungsbauwerke Saarland is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. DGKS piping, renamed intersecting structure; Saarland continuity register; object under consideration in the GDZ;; exported to GDZGDB; MultiFeatureclass is composed of a punctual featureclass GDZ2010.Pwlrhr and the corresponding business table with the factual data (GDZ2010.wlrhr), exported as a simple featureclass in Filegeodatabase; Attributes are explained in a separate file (see access - URL). Coverage: DE. Its keywords include Saarland, Binnengewässer. The listing shows 2019-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
